title: Urgent opening For Visual Content Creator - Motion Graphics, Video & A
description:
Visual Content Creator Motion Graphics, Video & AI 
 Company: Inogic Tech (India) Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Turbhe, Navi Mumbai
 Experience: 25 Years
 Work Mode: Work From Office 5 Days a Week
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Visual Content Creator with strong expertise in Graphic Design, Motion Graphics, Video Editing, Animation, and Digital Content Creation . 
 The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating engaging visual content for our B2B software and technology products , including social media creatives, product videos, promotional videos, motion graphics, presentations, and digital marketing campaigns. 
 Key Responsibilities Create engaging graphic designs, motion graphics, animations, and video content for digital platforms. Design creatives for social media, websites, blogs, email campaigns, presentations, and marketing campaigns . Create and edit product videos, promotional videos, explainer videos, reels, and short-form content . Develop motion graphics and animations using After Effects . Edit videos using Adobe Premiere Pro and other relevant tools. Convert complex B2B software and technology concepts into simple and visually appealing content. Collaborate with the Marketing, Product, Sales, and Content teams to understand creative requirements. Create visual content for B2B software, SaaS, IT products, and technology solutions . Maintain brand consistency across all creative assets. Repurpose existing content into different formats for social media and digital channels. Explore and leverage AI tools for creative ideation, image generation, video creation, animation, and content enhancement. Stay updated with the latest design, video, motion graphics, social media, and AI trends . 
 Required Skills 
 2–5 years of experience as a Visual Content Creator, Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer, Visual Designer, Multimedia Designer, or similar role . Strong hands-on experience with: Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe After Effects Adobe Premiere Pro Canva Strong understanding of Graphic Design, Motion Graphics, Animation, Video Editing, and Visual Storytelling . Good knowledge of typography, composition, layouts, visual hierarchy, and design principles . Ability to create content for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, websites, presentations, and other digital platforms . Creative mindset with strong attention to detail. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Preferred Skills Experience in a B2B Software, SaaS, IT, or Technology company . Experience creating software/product marketing content . Experience with AI-powered creative tools such as Midjourney, Runway, ChatGPT, or similar platforms. Understanding of digital marketing and social media content trends. Portfolio – Mandatory 
 Candidates must have a strong portfolio showcasing: Graphic Design Motion Graphics Video Editing Animation Social Media Creatives Product/Explainer Videos Digital Marketing Creatives 
 Interested candidates can send in their resume on jobs@inogic.com or whatsapp 8452974856
